title: Milestone reveal: 150+ launches
caption: The milestone-reveal recipe: one big metric over a soft radial glow and particle ring, with its label underneath, for anniversary posts and results slides.
prompt: Make a 6 second 16:9 milestone card for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, using the milestone-reveal style. The figure is "150+ websites and campaigns launched"; it is illustrative, so put it in claims.json and say so in a footnote on screen. Put our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) in the corner. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #d8c6b4, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, a touch of green #8acf31, Geist from fonts/. English on screen.
